text: Hi, can I help you? Yes, I’m in your Vietnamese conversation class. I wanted to talk to you about my grade on the last assignment. Okay, what’s wrong? I got a lower grade than I was expecting. I think there might have been a mistake. Let me take a look. It looks like you missed several key points in the conversation that were supposed to be included. Oh, I see. I didn’t realize that those were supposed to be included. Yes, those are important points to remember for future assignments. In addition, your grammar wasn’t as good as it could have been. Have you been practicing your Vietnamese outside of class? Yes, I’ve been trying, but it’s hard because I don’t have anyone to practice with. That’s understandable. It can be tough to find someone to practice with if you don’t know anyone who speaks Vietnamese. Maybe you can try finding online resources or apps that can help you practice grammar and vocabulary outside of class. Yeah, that sounds like a good idea. Thank you, Professor!
